card.name: Dollar sign in price conversions
card.fires_on: The dollar sign, often with an opening parenthesis, right after a price in another currency or a first price, where a dollar amount is given in brackets. Also a dollar-like symbol in a masked swear word.

modes.label: Bracketed dollar conversion
modes.description: A "($" opens a dollar equivalent right after a local currency amount or a product price.
modes.example: He took a loan of 12,000 taka<< ($>>174) from a local organization

modes.label: Dollar range or prefix
modes.description: A "$" in a dollar range or after "US" before an amount.
